title: Render an info-card via the in-process pilot

args.user_request: Show a quick info card about the new sprint freeze

data.title: Sprint freeze begins 2026-03-05
data.body: Mobile team is cutting a release branch; non-critical merges are paused until 2026-03-09.

notes: info-card is not a grounded type — no sources required. The executor validates data against the info-card schema, attaches render_target (default bottom_chat_drawer), and returns the envelope plus a one-line summary.

title: Render a grounded report-card with source citations

args.user_request: Summarize the latest sprint metrics into a report card

data.title: SP-20260429-0001 Phase B status
data.summary: 5 of 6 tickets merged; B2 dispatch_executor wiring in flight.

notes: report-card and document-viewer are grounded — at least one source with tool_use_id or tool_name is required. The executor stamps generated_at via its injected clock if the data does not already carry it.

title: Synthetic demo render — disclosure rides in the response summary

args.user_request: Sketch a metric card with sample latency numbers — just for the demo

notes: When the user invites a sketch / demo / test, set synthetic_allowed=true. The executor's response.Summary discloses the synthesis so you can pass that disclosure through to the user verbatim.

title: Unknown intent → invalid_intent failure (do not retry)
notes: v1 ships render_envelope only. Surface the failure to the user; do NOT auto-retry with a different intent. New intents land per executor-profile registration in Phase 3 of the executor-handoff rollout.
